data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Treaty Divisions (2015: primarily from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of GBP 95.7m in gross technical reserves for prior periods in 2016. This favorable development was primarily observed in the Energy and Treaty Divisions and was attributed to positive claims development on losses.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable claims development on losses during 2016

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -95.7m is described as a release of 'technical reserves' in respect of prior periods. While the context refers to 'claims development on losses', 'technical reserves' can include both claims outstanding and unearned premiums. The claims development triangle on page 33, when analyzed for prior year movements (excluding the two most recent underwriting years), indicates a net strengthening of approximately +269.6m, which contradicts the narrative release. The narrative statement on page 26 is used as the primary source for prior year development due to its explicit mention of 'prior periods' and 'release', but the discrepancy with the triangle is noted.
